attBesluta.text: I bought this as a place to keep my 'To Do' lists. The packing surprised me. It showed shipping damage on the outside but the glass was intact and the other parts were secured so nothing was lost or broken. The mounting was easy and the accessories are well thought out. The markers work well and so does the eraser. I do like how easy the surface is to clean. I also like how good the writing and drawings look thanks to the bright markers contrasting the dark background. The chalk markers will wipe off at the slightest touch which does make using this an acquired skill but even without practice, I'm able to make a checklist and a freehand calendar. The way I intend to use this, it should never wear out like other ones I used.
Just as i wanted, a well visible organizer reminder, i popped it up with and uv tube light and bought some uv reactive markers. Amazing
The blackboard is awesome and it went up easily. It did have a scuff in the glass on the bottom corner but it's hardly noticeable. I would definitely buy it again.
Quality is crazy, im very happy with it. Also the extra accessoires came with it.
Very pleased with purchase. Thus was the best price I could find.
Awesome, made well, it’s easy to hang, pay attention to where the hollow wall anchors go

Easy install. Works as advertised. Dry erase markers work. Chalk markers work. Looks great on the wall. Helps with communication between day/night shift. Comes with all hardware. If I had to choose one negative, the marker holder that sticks on the bottom could be better. If you need a marker board. Buy this.

Le tableau est de grande qualité en apparence. Très esthétique. Bonne finition. En revanche le petit support en alu ne tient pas bien. Il glisse et finit par tomber (au milieu de la nuit;). Autre petit point négatif, il faut des aimants puissants. Le métal étant derrière la vitre, ne compter pas pouvoir accrocher des liasses de papiers. Ces 2 petits défauts mis à part, le tableau en lui même est vraiment très bien. Le rendu noir est super et les marqueurs blancs marchent bien et offrent un beau contraste. Très classe.

It's a stable rolling rack. I use it without much rolling it. It's not for sprinting with it but when needed it can be moved easily and also blocked so that it woun't move when handling. A nice product for this price range
J'ai acheté ce produit dans un cadre professionnel et j'en suis plutôt satisfaite. Il est facile à monter et très stable.

Great product! These were the only jack posts I could find tall enough for the 12 foot ceilings in a garage I built. The price seemed too good to be true, but I couldn't ask for a better post. I would assume that most of the products Vevor sells are equally good quality and low price. Highly recommend.
Vorige week gekocht, handig als je het nodig heb voor bv een verbouwing

These jacks are exactly what I needed. The packaging was good and the jacks were secured eliminating any significant shipping movement. The paint finish is good without any paint overspray or poor painted areas. The overall quality is very nice. The height adjustment rod is nicely chromed. Fit and Finish are great. I would recommend if you need a similar jack.
